Matching events needed from other dossiers: republic-of-pisa (gain of Gallura 1287, Castel di Castro and a Cagliari third 1258), giudicato-of-arborea (gain of a Cagliari third 1258, some Logudoro land 1259), republic-of-genoa (Doria, Malaspina, Spinola holdings from Logudoro 1259), principality-of-capua (Amalfi 1034-1039), principality-of-salerno (Amalfi 1039-1073; Amalfi's rule of Salerno 981-983), norman-italy or kingdom-of-sicily (Amalfi 1073, 1101, 1131).

Cliopatria rows that end early: Cagliari at 1187 (judicate ran to 1258), Gallura at 1209 (ran to 1287); Logudoro has no shape for 1066-1071; Amalfi's row (960-1033) omits 839-959, the 1096-1100 and 1130-1131 revolts. All filled with new keyframes.

Pages cited for the three judicates are short and disagree on dates (Gallura end, Amalfi independence); every disagreement is in the dossier notes and in history/polities/_notes/eu-13-f.md. Cagliari, Gallura and Amalfi are within the page budget; Logudoro cites two extra thin pages (Arborea, Ardara) because they were opened.
Founding years of the three judicates are Cliopatria's 866 at confidence 1 although no page supports 866; a gap-filler may move them to c.1020 or c.1038.
